requirements: Verify OIDC issuer, audience, signature, token validity and session before forwarding.
Map verified immutable subject to user_id; authorize roles from trusted directory claims.
Strip all client-supplied x-cp-* headers, including duplicates; never forward bearer tokens as identity.
Sign the exact method, raw path, query and body received after all rewrites using auth.py canonical JSON bytes.
Create a new cryptographic nonce and signature on each retry and SSE reconnect.
Protect TLS, apply request body limits, disable SSE buffering and synchronize clocks.
Restrict backend network access to the signing proxy and monitoring; forbid anonymous fallback.
Verify cross-user REST and SSE isolation with real proxy identities before opening traffic.
